newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE continues to weaken in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE continues to weaken in quiet market.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices weakened on Friday as slow trade and a lack of interest took its toll on the market, players said.
Players said there was little news Friday and that most of the interest was focused on prompt supply given the steep backwardation in NYMEX gasoline futures.
In New York Harbor, a blender bought a parcel at 97.00 cents, although sellers held at Wednesday's 98.00 cent level.
Spot Houston MTBE in the U.S. Gulf drifted down about two cents from Wednesday to a sleepy range of 91.50/92.50 cents.
"It is extremely quiet," said a Gulf broker.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631--
